name: Vanta MCP Server
description: Enables management of Vanta compliance platform resources including controls, vulnerabilities, vendors, and policies through natural language. Supports multi-tenant OAuth2 authentication for secure access to security and compliance data.

rawRecord.description: Enables management of Vanta compliance platform resources including controls, vulnerabilities, vendors, and policies through natural language. Supports multi-tenant OAuth2 authentication for secure access to security and compliance data.

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the server (also accepts legacy PORT variable).

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

AUTH_TOKEN.description: If set, clients must send Authorization: Bearer <AUTH_TOKEN> to access /mcp and /sse endpoints.

API_BASE_URL.description: Vanta API base URL for the default tenant.

TRANSPORT_MODE.description: Informational — both /mcp and /sse are always active.

OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Default tenant: Vanta OAuth2 client ID (vci_...). Required for single-tenant mode if not using config/tenants.json.

OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Default tenant: Vanta OAuth2 client secret (vcs_...). Required for single-tenant mode if not using config/tenants.json.
